sources.information: The Australian site identifies its Byron Bay festival as unrelated to Harbor Echo in Castlewellan; it provides no Castlewellan festival facts.

Official Castlewellan festival programme confirms the 2027 dates, outdoor music programme, venue and address, free admission, and official website. It says no other editions are announced and no participant estimate is published.

summary.value: Recurring outdoor music festival held at Castlewellan Grounds in Northern Ireland.
summary.reason: The official programme identifies Harbor Echo as the recurring Castlewellan festival and describes its 2027 programme as outdoor music.

year.reason: The official programme identifies this as Harbor Echo Castlewellan 2027.

dates.reason: The official programme confirms the festival dates as 23–30 January 2027.

scheduleStatus.reason: The official programme publishes the 2027 programme and confirmed dates.
